result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The example from the task now gives Anna 2 and Bob 1.

- **`DataStore.java`** (`findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`, ~line 6516): the purchase-order subquery gets `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the quarter and weekday reports use. The javadoc now says cancelled orders are left out. Reps with no purchase orders still appear with 0, sorted as before.
- **`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`**: new `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted` test. It builds the task's example (Anna: one sent, one received; Bob: one sent, two cancelled) and expects `Anna:2, Bob:1`.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes offline. My first run of the new test failed because I had set up the data wrong, not because of the fix. I corrected the data and did not change the query again.

I did not run `DemoScenarioTest`: the command was blocked by the permission check, and the Maven run afterwards returned no output, so I can't confirm it ran. Nothing is committed.

Not changed: `findPurchaseOrderCountPerCountry`, just below, has the same missing cancelled filter. The task only covers the per-rep report, so I left it. It is a one-line change if you want it too.
